title: Payment Retry Code Review
summary: The review identifies a duplicate-charge risk in the payment retry flow, a missing regression test, and a readability concern in order payload construction.

merge_readiness.reason: The reviewer explicitly says the change should not be merged yet because the retry path can create duplicate charges.

findings.title: Retry can create duplicate charges
findings.problem: The function retries after a timeout without checking whether the provider accepted the first request. A delayed provider response can therefore produce a second charge.
findings.impact: A customer may be charged twice for one order.
findings.suggested_fix: Send an idempotency key and query the first request before retrying.

related_findings.note: The missing test leaves the duplicate-charge path unprotected.
Both paths construct provider requests differently.

findings.title: Missing delayed-success retry regression test
findings.problem: There is no test for a provider timeout followed by a successful delayed response.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a regression test covering that sequence.

related_findings.note: The test should cover the duplicate-charge scenario.

findings.title: Validation and mapping are mixed
findings.problem: The payload construction mixes validation and mapping.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract validation into a separate function.

related_findings.note: Both paths construct provider requests differently.

positives.text: The transaction boundary is clear and the rollback behavior is tested well.
